item.title: Nepal interim PM says elections crucial for 'determining our future'
item.description: Nepal's interim leader Sushila Karki called for peaceful elections on Thursday, the first polls since deadly 2025 anti-corruption protests toppled the government."Every vote is important in determining our future," the 73-year-old former chief justice, who came out of retirement to lead the South Asian nation, said in a statement."Thank you for your patience and understanding, for ensuring a peaceful election."

item.description: The government has announced an additional public holiday on March 18 to facilitate smooth travel for homebound passengers during Eid.As a result, government employees will enjoy a seven-day consecutive holiday from March 17 to March 23 during the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr.The decision was taken at a cabinet meeting held on Thursday at the Secretariat.
